question: The Bhagirathi and Alaknanda join to form the Ganga at _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devprayag**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Bhagirathi** and **Alaknanda** rivers converge at **Devprayag** in the state of Uttarakhand, India, to form the Ganga River.
 
• Devprayag is one of the **Panch Prayags** (five confluences) of the Alaknanda River.
 
• The Bhagirathi originates from the **Gaumukh Glacier**, while the Alaknanda originates from the **Satopanth Glacier**.
 
• At Devprayag, the waters of Bhagirathi are clearer and swifter, while Alaknanda's waters are slightly muddy and slower.
 
• This confluence is considered **sacred in Hinduism** and attracts pilgrims from across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Panch Prayags:**

 
 
• The five sacred confluences of rivers in Uttarakhand are **Vishnuprayag**, **Nandaprayag**, **Karnaprayag**, **Rudraprayag**, and **Devprayag**.
 
• These Prayags are part of the pilgrimage routes in the **Garhwal Himalayas**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Ganga River:**
 
 
• The Ganga is regarded as a **sacred river** in Hinduism and is associated with spiritual purification.
 
• It flows through several Indian states, including Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, and West Bengal, before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
 
• **Hydrological Importance:**
 
 
• The Ganga and its tributaries support millions of people by providing water for irrigation, drinking, and industrial use.
 
• The river system is vital for agriculture in the Ganges Basin, one of the most fertile regions in the world.
 
 
 
• **Devprayag's Location:**
 
 
• Devprayag is located at an altitude of around 830 meters (2,723 feet) above sea level.
 
• It is a small town in the **Tehri Garhwal district** of Uttarakhand and serves as a key spot for pilgrims traveling to the Char Dham Yatra.
